parameters.fetchXml:
<!--
Created from query:

SELECT TOP 50 tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid,
              tps_webrorumei,
              contact_r.contactid,
              contact_r.fullname,
              contact_r.emailaddress1,
              contact.contactid,
              contact.fullname,
              contact.emailaddress1
FROM   tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm
       INNER JOIN
       tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact AS contact_r
       ON contact_r.tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid = tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm.tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid
       INNER JOIN
       contact AS contact
       ON contact.contactid = contact_r.contactid
       And statecode = 0
WHERE  tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid in ('75ca01f0-0227-ef11-840b-000d3a7894bd','5faf3d4c-c627-ef11-840a-00224866de73') and statecode=0;
-->

<fetch>
  <entity name="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm">
    <attribute name="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid" />
    <attribute name="tps_webrorumei" />
    <filter>
      <condition attribute="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid" operator="in">
 @{concat('<value>', replace(trim(triggerBody()?['text_1']), ',', '</value> <value>'), '</value>')}
      </condition>
      <condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0" />
    </filter>
    <link-entity name="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact" from="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid" to="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid" link-type="inner" alias="contact_r" intersect="true">
      <link-entity name="contact" from="contactid" to="contactid" alias="contact" intersect="true">
        <attribute name="contactid" />
        <attribute name="fullname" />
        <attribute name="emailaddress1" />
        <filter>
          <condition attribute="tps_shoninsutetasu" operator="eq" value="2" />
          <condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0" />
        </filter>
      </link-entity>
    </link-entity>
  </entity>
</fetch>

parameters.fetchXml:
<!--
Created from query:

SELECT TOP 50 tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm.tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid,
              tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm.tps_webrorumei,
              contact.contactid,
              contact.fullname,
              contact.emailaddress1,
              contact.parentcustomerid
FROM   tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm
       INNER JOIN
       tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact AS contact_r
       ON contact_r.tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid = tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm.tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid
       INNER JOIN
       contact AS contact
       ON contact.contactid = contact_r.contactid 
       And statecode = 0
       INNER JOIN 
       account ON contact.parentcustomerid = account.accountid
       And account.accountid = '53ad8a95-0f18-ef11-840a-6045bd6727d4'
       And statecode = 0 
       
WHERE  tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid in ('75ca01f0-0227-ef11-840b-000d3a7894bd','5faf3d4c-c627-ef11-840a-00224866de73') and statecode=0;
-->

<fetch>
  <entity name="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm">
    <attribute name="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid" />
    <attribute name="tps_webrorumei" />
    <filter>
      <condition attribute="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid" operator="in">
        @{concat('<value>',replace(trim(triggerBody()?['text_1']),',','</value> <value>'),'</value>')}
      </condition>
      <condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0" />
    </filter>
    <link-entity name="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact" from="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid" to="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid" link-type="inner" alias="contact_r" intersect="true">
      <link-entity name="contact" from="contactid" to="contactid" alias="contact" intersect="true">
        <attribute name="contactid" />
        <attribute name="fullname" />
        <attribute name="emailaddress1" />
        <filter>
          <condition attribute="tps_shoninsutetasu" operator="eq" value="2" />
          <condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0" />
        </filter>
        <link-entity name="account" from="accountid" to="parentcustomerid" alias="account_r">
          <attribute name="accountid" />
          <filter>
            <condition attribute="accountid" operator="eq" value="@{triggerBody()?['text_2']}" alias="account"  />
            <condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0" />
          </filter>
        </link-entity>
      </link-entity>
    </link-entity>
  </entity>
</fetch>

parameters.fetchXml:
<!--
Created from query:

SELECT    tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact.tps_webrorumei,
          tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact.tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid,
          tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact.contactid,
          tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact.fullname,
          tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact.emailaddress1,
          contact.contactid,
          contact.fullname,
          contact.emailaddress1
FROM   contact
       INNER JOIN
       tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact AS tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact
       ON tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact.contactid = contact.contactid
       INNER JOIN
       tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm AS tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm
       ON tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm.tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid = tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact.tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid
          AND tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm.statecode = 0
       INNER JOIN
       tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact AS tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact
       ON tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact.tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid = tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm.tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid
       INNER JOIN
       contact AS contact
       ON contact.contactid = tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact.contactid
          AND contact.tps_shoninsutetasu= 2
          AND contact.statecode = 0
WHERE  (contactid = '4d224d23-e917-ef11-840a-002248697aed'
        AND tps_shoninsutetasu = 2
        AND statecode = 0);
-->

<fetch>
  <entity name="contact">
    <filter>
      <condition attribute="contactid" operator="in">
        @{concat('<value>', replace(trim(triggerBody()?['text']), ',', '</value> <value>'), '</value>')}
      </condition>
      <condition attribute="tps_shoninsutetasu" operator="eq" value="2" />
      <condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0" />
    </filter>
    <link-entity name="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact" from="contactid" to="contactid" intersect="true">
      <link-entity name="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm" from="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid" to="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid" alias="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm" intersect="true">
        <attribute name="tps_webrorumei" />
        <attribute name="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid" />
        <filter>
          <condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0" />
        </filter>
        <link-entity name="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibm_contact" from="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid" to="tps_pageswebroru_mst_ibmid" intersect="true">
          <link-entity name="contact" from="contactid" to="contactid" alias="contact" intersect="true">
            <attribute name="contactid" />
            <attribute name="fullname" />
            <attribute name="emailaddress1" />
            <filter>
              <condition attribute="tps_shoninsutetasu" operator="eq" value="2" />
              <condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0" />
            </filter>
          </link-entity>
        </link-entity>
      </link-entity>
    </link-entity>
  </entity>
</fetch>
